messages:
marco: Heads-up — scheduling a staggered node reboot across us-west2 and eu-central to pick up NIC firmware and a kubelet hotfix. Planning a 3-cohort drain to avoid capacity cliffs.

karen: timeline?

marco: Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. Cohort sizes ~45-55 nodes. Order: cohort-A (us-west2-n1..n50), cohort-B (eu-central-n1..n50), cohort-C mixed. We'll prewarm backfill and throttle admissions.

ajay: Impact to Dedicated pools / reserved capacity?

marco: Dedicated pools will be isolated — we won't drain reserved-only nodes. But some routed hosted traffic may be impacted; we'll enable routing fallback to burst and cross-region for stateless short jobs.

lucy: Can we freeze model rollouts and cache TTLs during the window? KV-cache regen spikes + model swaps will amplify load.

marco: Good call. Requesting DEVEX to freeze rollouts + set prefix cache TTL=48h for affected models during the window. I'll add to rollout plan.

devex-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-cohort-A at 02:12 UTC (5 nodes) — automated smoke + latency probes.

sre-bot: Planned drain command template:
```
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=600s --pod-selector='app!=critical-sidecar'
```
Followed by reboot and kubelet restart. Health-checks to rejoin afterwards.

marco: Health checks: p95 gen latency, token-serving throughput, and eviction rate. Thresholds set in the runbook (5% eviction or 2x latency => pause window).

catie: Customer comms? we should pre-post ASAP.

marco: Yes — status.redwood.ai banner + targeted email to enterprise accounts in affected regions. We'll include expected start, cohorts, and fallback behavior.

karen: Cost/ops overhead? any backfill spend estimate?

marco: Estimated warm-backfill delta ~3% regionally for the 3-hour window. Rough cost: ~$6k per region for the event (GPU hours + cross-region egress/top-up). We'll monitor CloudBilling alarms.

ajay: Rollback plan if SLOs breach?

marco: If SLO breach detected: 1) Halt further drains, 2) Re-schedule reboots, 3) Enable model routing fallback to smaller but cheaper L1 instances, 4) Escalate to PagerDuty. We have an automated rollback flag in the orchestration service: "soft-failover".

lucy: I'll also freeze quantization/pack config changes and pin the production model variants for the window.

marco: Thanks — ops checklist updated and linked: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/node-reboot.

karen: I'll be on prep shift. tagging: @ajay @lucy @catie for runbook review tomorrow 16:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

marco: Perfect. Quick note for oncall — watch for sudden +30% KV-cache misses or >5% pod evictions; we may throttle admissions earlier than scheduled. I'll post a final confirmation 1h before start.

devex-bot: Reminder scheduled 1h before window.

sre-bot: When drains start, I'll post updates in this thread and add per-cohort messages with node lists and start/finish timestamps.

marco: Closing — any last Qs?

ajay: None from me. Good plan. :rocket:

catie: none

lucy: all good

marco: ok — see you in prep channel 01:30 UTC.
